description: Kiriran wears a cream ankle-length undertunic with a small slit neckline beneath a long open-front brown textured outer robe. Narrow gold-brown geometric woven borders run down the robe's front and around its cuffs. A broad dark brown and gold patterned woven sash encircles the waist, with long fringed ends hanging down. Cream cuffs show at the wrists. Brown closed leather-like shoes are visible below the robe. Cloth looks breathable and woven, with a linen-like underlayer and soft textured outer cloth, but exact fibers are uncertain. The outfit is substantial and opaque, with no headgear, armor, weapon or oversized ornament.
